objects.description: [APT38](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0082) has used Finder, a macOS native app with FDA permissions, to rename the folder `com.apple.TCC`, then used another process to move the `TCC.db` file to a new location, where SQLite3 was used to edit `TCC.db`. The edited `TCC.db` file allowed code signing authorization, permission access, etc. without requiring a user prompt.(Citation: MIcrosoft Mastra npm Compromise JUN 2026)
